summary: Expanded the AI data-center power/thermal node with a two-lane lens. Vertiv remains the high-attention reference anchor for integrated power and cooling, while the discovery lane points to Powell Industries, Modine Manufacturing, and nVent as more specific second-order suppliers tied to medium-voltage switchgear, data-center cooling capacity, coolant distribution units, liquid-cooling manifolds, racks, and high-density power distribution. Current market caps are mostly above the original USD 300M-10B hunting range, suggesting the market has begun repricing the chokepoint, but the industrial classifications and customer/order-level details may still leave some AI exposure underappreciated versus obvious semiconductor names.
